citationText: RSA is a public-key cryptosystem for both encryption and authentication supported by RSA Data Security Inc. See: R. L. Rivest, A. Shamir, and L.M. Adleman. A method for obtaining digital signatures and public-key cryptosystems. Communications of the ACM, 21(2): 120-126, February 1978.
